capabilities: Translate notes, folders and PDFs into Chinese with page-aligned output
Read original and translation in a locked side-by-side view with synchronized scrolling
Protect LaTeX, code blocks and wikilinks during translation and enforce a glossary
Import PDFs as page-marked markdown in text or vision mode
Export interleaved or translation-only bilingual documents
extras: Manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Roadmap lists planned cost-reduction features; settings include a bilingual interface (Chinese/English) and Test buttons to verify provider, key and model.
problem: Existing translators produce a separate Chinese copy of a note, so reading imported English books and papers loses page alignment and breaks formulas during translation.

relations.evidence: works with OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot Kimi, Zhipu, SiliconFlow, Ollama and any /chat/completions endpoint
relations.plugin: OpenAI-compatible endpoints (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot Kimi, Zhipu, SiliconFlow, Ollama)

paid API usage costs for OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic or Gemini providers

summary: Translates English books and papers into Chinese with page-aligned bilingual side-by-side reading, LaTeX-safe handling, glossary control and PDF import.
